Hi Alicia / Rajesh —

Following up with the technical matrix and concrete answers to the noisy-neighbor / isolation questions. TL;DR below, details after.

TL;DR
- Hosted API (multi-tenant): designed for scale and fast onboarding. Isolation: logical multi-tenant with quota-based throttling and automated load shedding; typically good for steady, lower-p95 workloads. We do not provide hard GPU isolation on Hosted.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools pinned to your account. Provides hardware isolation (no noisy neighbors on the same GPU instance), configurable SLOs, and prioritized scheduling. Good fit for strict p95/p99 latency needs.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full network isolation, customer-controlled KMS, and extended audit logs — for regulated workloads needing control over egress and data handling.

Noise / noisy-neighbor specifics
- On Hosted, noisy neighbor incidents manifest as tail latency spikes when a co-tenant runs a high concurrency or long context job; we mitigate with continuous batching and prefix caching but cannot guarantee hard isolation.
- Dedicated pools: we allocate node-level isolation and exclusive GPU allocation for critical pools. In practice, this eliminates co-tenant interference for inference workloads.
- We offer a compensation policy for documented noisy-neighbor incidents on Hosted if they materially impact SLOs; Dedicated contracts include a stronger SLA with monetary credits tied to latency SLO misses.

SLO & monitoring
- Typical target SLOs we offer on Dedicated: p95 <= 120ms (regional), p99 <= 250ms for standard small-context models. Custom SLOs negotiable based on workload profile and commit level.
- Monitoring: per-route latency heatmaps, token-level traces, request IDs, and full audit logs (for Private/Dedicated). We can stream traces to your observability stack (Datadog/CloudWatch).

Operational integration
- Networking: Dedicated supports VPC peering and static egress IPs for allowlisting. Private supports customer-managed VPC and on-prem connectors.
- Auth/keys: KMS integration for Private; Dedicated supports customer-managed keys in many cases.
- Onboarding: we run a short perf validation with a controlled traffic replay to confirm p95/p99 under your profile.

Attachments included: short SOC2 summary, network diagram. I can also share a one-page pricing / SLA comparison if helpful.

1) Marissa: schedule Thu 18th 11am PT deep-dive (confirmed by Alicia)
2) Alicia/Rajesh: share a 1-hour traffic replay or representative qps histogram and any max-concurrency workloads
3) Priyom: prepare a pricing/SLA comparison and a short test plan for perf validation.

Happy to answer any specific questions before the call.

Thanks,
